items.context: Aapko kitni rakam ka loan lena hai?
items.text: ek lakh

items.context: Aapki loan ki total amount kya hai?
items.text: pachaas hazaar

items.context: Aapka agla EMI kab due hai?
items.text: dusri tarikh
mera loan ka EMI kitna banta hai agle mahine
please mujhe apne account se EMI deduction ka status batao
kya aap mujhe is mahine ki EMI ki due date bata sakte ho
main apne loan account number se EMI details chah raha hu
mera account number hai 1234 5678 9012 EMI ki jaankari milegi
last EMI kab pay kiya tha aur agla kab hoga mujhe jankari do
EMI amount me kuch extra paisa kata gaya hai kya ye batao

items.context: Aapka loan account number kya hai?
items.text: mujhe apna loan account number batana hoga EMI ke liye

items.context: Aap kitna EMI pay karte hain?
items.text: main har mahine 15000 ka EMI jama karta hu

items.context: Aapko apne EMI ki due date chahiye?
items.text: due date 25 april tak hi hai har mahine

items.context: Kya aapko EMI deduction ka proof chahiye?
items.text: mai chahata hu mujhe deduction ka receipt bhejo

items.context: Kya aapka naam bank me registered hai?
items.text: payer name Rahul verma bank me EMI ke liye registered hai
mujhe apne personal loan ki EMI details chahiye kya aap check kar sakte hain please
mera aakhri EMI deduction 10 march ko hua tha lekin uska confirmation nahi mila hai
bank ne mere account se EMI kat liya par mujhe transaction SMS nahi aaya hai

items.context: Aapko apna loan account number maloom hai?
items.text: mera loan account number kya hai ye batane ke liye thoda madad karo please

items.context: Aap apni EMI ka poora hisaab lena chahte hain?
items.text: aaj tak EMI ke liye 25000 ka deduction hua hai par due date ka pata nahi

items.context: Kya aapko dono dates dekhna hai?
items.text: kya aap mujhe mera pichhla aur agla dono EMI ki date bata sakte hain

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: banking
Intent: loan_emi_query - asks about a loan EMI amount, due date or a deduction
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with numbers (account and phone numbers, OTPs, amounts, dates) written as numerals, with long numbers spaced in groups the way people say them

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
